milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate close to the trapped chest at relative position [7, 1, 7] (inside the cobblestone shelter) and be facing toward it, confirming visual discovery. max_distance=5 covers the doorway area and interior. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the chest.

Uses inventory_has because this is an acquire/pickup task. The player starts with no diamonds, so any diamond in inventory must have been looted from the trapped chest. min_count=1 is lenient — the chest contains 3 diamonds but the player only needs to take at least one to complete the task.
